title: Fix QR flow: invoice generation and delivery panel assignment issues

requirements.text: Fix invoice generation so that when an order's QR code is scanned or when the invoice modal is opened, the invoice is correctly fetched and rendered with all order details, store info, line items, and the QR code. Trace the full call path from InvoiceModal → InvoiceView → backend queries and ensure the order ID lookup, store lookup, and data assembly succeed without errors. Add defensive null/undefined checks for all fields rendered in InvoiceView.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the invoice modal for any order displays the fully rendered invoice with order details, store info, and QR code.
No console errors or blank states appear when the invoice modal is opened.
If order or store data is momentarily loading, a skeleton/loading state is shown rather than a crash or empty render.
The print button in InvoiceView functions correctly.

requirements.text: Fix the delivery assignment flow so that after an admin assigns an order to a delivery user (sets assignedDeliveryUser on the order), that order immediately appears in the DeliveryDashboard for the assigned delivery user. Audit the backend assignOrder / updateOrder logic to confirm assignedDeliveryUser is persisted correctly. Audit useQueries.ts to confirm the delivery dashboard query filters orders by the logged-in user's principal/ID against assignedDeliveryUser. Fix any mismatch between how the assignment is stored and how it is queried.

quotes: after assign to delivery it's not showing in delivery panel

acceptanceCriteria: After an admin assigns an order to a delivery user, that order appears in the delivery user's DeliveryDashboard without requiring a page reload beyond normal React Query refetch.
The delivery dashboard only shows orders assigned to the currently logged-in delivery user.
Orders with statuses 'Dispatched' and 'Out for Delivery' are visible to the assigned delivery user.
No orders from other delivery users are shown in the panel.

requirements.text: Fix the end-to-end QR scan flow across all role-based pipeline stages (admin, staff, delivery) in ScanPage and DeliveryDashboard. Ensure that: (1) the QRScanModal camera activates reliably, (2) the scanned value is correctly decoded using the VITALIST-prefix logic in qrGenerator.ts / orderUtils.ts, (3) the decoded order ID is matched to a real order in the backend, and (4) the appropriate status transition mutation is called and confirmed. Handle cases where the scanned QR value does not match any order by showing a clear error message.

quotes: The qr flow is not going throw

acceptanceCriteria: Scanning a valid order QR code in any role-based scan flow (admin, staff, delivery) correctly identifies the order and triggers the status update.
The camera activates without errors when the QR scan modal is opened.
A successfully scanned and processed QR code shows a success confirmation to the user.
Scanning an unrecognized or malformed QR code shows a user-friendly error message instead of crashing.
The DistributorWorkflowDialog barcode scan step also correctly resolves the scanned order and proceeds to the image upload step.

requirements.text: Audit and fix the QRPrintView and QRCodeDisplay components to ensure the QR code image URL is generated correctly using qrGenerator.ts (with the VITALIST-prefixed, base64-encoded order ID) and that the image loads without CORS or URL encoding errors. Verify the QR code printed/displayed encodes exactly the value the scan decoder expects.

quotes: The qr flow is not going throw

acceptanceCriteria: QR codes displayed in QRCodeDisplay and QRPrintView load successfully as images.
The encoded value in the QR image matches the format expected by the scan decoder (VITALIST prefix + base64 order ID).
Scanning a printed/displayed QR code resolves to the correct order in the backend.

constraints: Do not change the authentication or Internet Identity flows.
Do not alter immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, or src/components/ui.
Preserve all existing role-based access control logic in the backend and frontend.
All Motoko changes must remain within the single-actor pattern in backend/main.mo.
nonGoals: Adding new order statuses or workflow stages.
Redesigning the UI layout or visual theme.
